name: @cotizador/desktop
description: Aplicación de escritorio Electron — Cotizador Solar
author: MrMikeDev

scripts.build:electron: cd ../.. && bun build apps/desktop/electron/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir=apps/desktop/electron/dist --external=electron --external=better-sqlite3 --external=@prisma/client --external=@prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3 --external=@hyzyla/pdfium --external=tesseract.js --external=unpdf --external=pngjs && bun build apps/desktop/electron/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external=electron --outfile=apps/desktop/electron/dist/preload.cjs
scripts.dist: bun run build:electron && node scripts/verificar-empaquetado.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
